senses.gloss: to degrade, profane. Part. pass. חָלִיל, f. חֲלִילָא.

units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 22:26">Targ. Ez. XXII, 26</cite> <he>וְחַלַת</he>.
Targ. Prov. XXX, 9; a. e.—Part. pass. מְחַלַּל, f. מְחַלְלָא, מְחַלָּא.

<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 21:7">Targ. O. Lev. XXI, 7</cite> (ed. Berl. <cite ref="M00887"><he>מַחְלָא</he></cite>, Regia <cite ref="M00887"><he>מְחָלָא</he></cite>).—Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ top, a. e. <he>דילמא דחַלְּלִינָן וכ׳</he> did we perhaps desecrate the Sabbath?—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 44b:10">B. Mets. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>טבעא אפירא לא מְחַלְּלִינָן</he> we dare not redeem coins with goods.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Amos 2:7">Targ. Am. II, 7</cite> <he>לאָחָלָא</he> (ed. Lag. <he>לאפסא</he>); a. fr.—Part. pass. f. <cite ref="M00887"><he>מַחְלָא</he></cite>, v. supra.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 36:23">Targ. Ez. XXXVI, 23</cite> (not <cite ref="H01074"><he>אַתְּחַל</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 7:24">Ib. VII, 24</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 51a">Snh. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>היכא דמִיתַּחֲלָא השתא</he> if she degraded herself now; <he>מית׳ וקיימא</he> she was degraded before this.
